notes: SV3C uses two distinct path schemes by series: A Series (and Upgraded A Series) uses /stream0 (main) and /stream1 (sub) on port 554 with credentials in the URL (rtsp://admin:PW@IP/stream0). HX Series (both POE and WiFi) uses /11 (main) and /12 (sub/vice) on port 554. The A Series PDF also documents /video1 (main video only), /video2 (sub video only), and /audio (audio only) paths. Default credentials: admin / 123456. Default IP: 192.168.0.123.
